issues.summary: Exact realized Student-t, Gaussian control and Toy2D tensors are not present in the audited input locations. Their constructors generate new values before the experiment runner sets the model seed. Reconstructing from matrix/split seeds does not recover historical data.
issues.resolution: Obtain the exact archived data, splits and mixing matrices for each reported comparison; do not regenerate.

issues.summary: All six expected aniso_gauss_d32_k{k}.pt inputs are missing; only meta.json is retained.
issues.resolution: Obtain original cached files; generator seed42 is not authorization to regenerate.

issues.summary: Paper B.1/C.7 specifies batch256 for Student-t and PIV. Commit2e659c7 defaults are4096; f892493 defaults are256 but E1/E6/E8/E10 YAMLs remain4096. The specific archived comparison configuration is unresolved. Later PIV d64/d256 completion metadata resolves their main comparisons to256; those two conditions are no longer blocked by this issue.
issues.resolution: Identify exact cached-data/config/result grouping for the reported values. Do not silently substitute a default; paper target is256.

issues.summary: Paper C.5 lists native8x4 PIV d32; piv_d32.pt is absent. d16 backing storage is not verified provenance for this input.
issues.resolution: Obtain verified native d32 cached file or authoritative proof of storage identity before materializing any view.

issues.summary: Historical E10 angular records use chronological split/201 samples, but paper Tables1/3 match later outputs/exp1_main_benchmark/piv_d64 angular records and RAFM_ANG_TABLE1_completion.json:randomseed0,10000 samples,batch256.
issues.resolution: Use later main-table records and retain E10 as distinct historical context; do not take the E10 aggregate as the paper main row.

issues.summary: Paper C.10 says the3925 official-validation reference images are disjoint from generator training and all FM methods use3000 generated images. Local extraction concatenates official train+val13394 images and trainer random-splits all rows60/20/20. It saves no row-to-image split manifest. Angular launcher requests5000.
issues.resolution: Obtain exact paper training/validation/test row indices and image mapping, verify reference disjointness, pin3000 FM evaluation count. Do not silently resplit.

issues.summary: Original downstream per-seed eval JSONs are absent in the audited tree; aggregated JSONs survive. Published vector values also differ from retained generated table TeX.
issues.resolution: Recover cited-commit per-seed records or preserve paper values as immutable reported references with explicit unmatched-input provenance.

issues.summary: Paper C.12 calls for shared projection directions within each comparison but no fixed projection seed; current evaluators draw from method-specific post-training RNG state. Exact old projection arrays/RNG state are absent.
issues.resolution: Use documented common new projection arrays across newly evaluated methods; do not claim bit-identical historical projections.

issues.summary: Some angular run configs say nfe512 steps, but final metrics record512 model evaluations; resample_matched_nfe.py resampled at128 RK4 steps without changing YAML.
issues.resolution: Use128 RK4 steps/512 actual evaluations; retain original config and resampling provenance.

issues.detail: Paper C.12 describes bandwidth fixed across compared methods; retained compute_mmd selects the median separately from each generated/test concatenation and records no bandwidth. New runs reuse that evaluator unchanged; exact historical common bandwidth cannot be recovered from metrics alone.
issues.resolution: Report existing-code median-heuristic MMD and disclose this limitation. A common-bandwidth reevaluation needs original samples and separate evaluation approval.
